entities.summary: Renato Marino Mazzacurati was an Italian painter and sculptor belonging to the modern movement of the Scuola romana , of eclectic styles and able within his career span to represent the artistic currents of Cubism, Expressionism, and Realism. He believed that art could sustain social functions.
